Allowed origins (via the `cors()` middleware's `origin` function in **`worker/src/index.ts`**, lines ~20-30):

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any subdomain of `.pages.dev`
- any subdomain of `.workers.dev`

Anything else returns `null` (rejected).

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that same `origin` callback in `worker/src/index.ts` (inside `app.use('*', cors({ origin: (origin) => { ... } }))`), adding a check like `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` or an `.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` clause before the final `return null`. Note arrays with exact strings won't support wildcard subdomains — hence the function form. Related note: `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 CORS`.
